preheader: Tech sell-offs hit Anthropic's valuation, $11M in Nvidia gear stolen, and Olivier Rioux dominates for UCI.

lead.headline: Anthropic weighs a lower valuation for its massive IPO as AI stocks stumble
lead.body: Anthropic may have to lower its valuation targets, potentially dropping closer to $1 trillion from an expected $1.5 trillion. Major investors are pulling back as a broader tech sell-off and fears over strict data center regulations spook Wall Street.
lead.why: This is a masterclass in market sentiment shifts. As an aspiring investor, watch how macroeconomic pressures and regulatory fears can compress tech valuations overnight, even for industry leaders.

stories.headline: Thieves make off with $11.4 million in Nvidia hardware in Oakland
stories.body: Authorities are investigating a sophisticated cargo heist that targeted more than $11 million worth of Nvidia computer hardware in Oakland, California.
stories.why: Supply chain security is a massive hidden cost for hardware companies. If you consult for tech firms or look at logistics startups, physical asset protection is just as critical as software security.

stories.headline: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Cyber with a critical cybersecurity rating
stories.body: OpenAI has released GPT-6 Cyber to a small group of vetted customers. The new model is built to identify software security weaknesses and help security teams fix vulnerabilities.
stories.why: Cybersecurity AI tools are a booming enterprise market. Think about how consulting firms will need to audit these automated tools for corporate clients.

term.name: Valuation
term.definition: Valuation is the process of determining the current worth of a asset or a company. When public tech markets pull back and investors demand lower pricing for upcoming IPOs like Anthropic's, private startups often see their valuations adjusted downward to match public market realities.

serve.headline: Zipline raised $1.5 billion at a $21.5 billion valuation to expand drone delivery
serve.body: Drone delivery startup Zipline secured massive new funding to scale its autonomous delivery network across the U.S. alongside an expanded partnership with Walmart.
questions: How does Zipline's unit economics change as they scale drone delivery sites to Walmart locations?
What customer acquisition costs do logistics startups face when expanding into suburban residential areas?
